artist_policy: Only exact native credits of each selected recording supply artist observations. Never inherit credits or musical style from the whole candidate component.
baseline_proof: Reconstructed nearest-five recording identities and distances must exactly match the pinned crossfit evidence before producing a comparison. Abort on disagreement.
component_policy: Keep the nearest recording per known candidate credit component before the existing top-five truncation; same distance/MBID ordering. No padding, relaxed gate, alternate contract, fold selection, new fit or cross-cell score pooling.
denominators: All 100 source nominations and all 18 contract/fold cells retained; every abstention unchanged. Compare all already emitted queries, including those with no diversity change.
interpretation: Optional structural retrieval diagnostic against already inspected historical outputs. Component or exact-credit coverage is not listener relevance, recommendation quality, genre accuracy or EveryNoise parity. Existing nearest-recording inference stays unchanged.
metrics: union and per-query exact credited candidate artists
scoring: For already emitted own-fold queries only, reconstruct Euclidean distance to every supported frozen candidate in the exact contract/fold frame. Exclude self and the entire known query credit component. Raw distance then native recording MBID ties.
